newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt policeman shot dead by suspected Islamists.
newsitem.headline: Egypt policeman shot dead by suspected Islamists.

text.p: An Egyptian police major was killed and four soldiers wounded on Tuesday when suspected Moslem militants opened fire on them in an ambush in southern Egypt, security sources said.
The attack occurred in the village of Safay in Minya province, they said. The security forces were patrolling fields in the area when they were ambushed.
The gunmen were suspected of belonging to the militant Islamic group Gama'a Islamiya, which wants to overthrow the Egyptian government and set up an Islamic state.
